title_zh: 发现厨房老鼠后约定停用与报修

scenario.goal_zh: 说明老鼠出现的位置，约定停用厨房并联系管理员处理暴露食材和害虫

context_zh: 合租者在共用厨房发现害虫，商量通知管理员。
author: author-phase09-a

sentences.speaker: Hana
sentences.text: I just saw a rat go behind the fridge.

sentences.speaker: Luis
sentences.text: Was the bowl of raw vegetables on the counter uncovered?

sentences.speaker: Hana
sentences.text: Yes. I won't use those for dinner. We need to tell everyone not to use the kitchen for now.

sentences.speaker: Luis
sentences.text: I'll call the building manager and ask how they plan to get rid of the rats.

sentences.speaker: Hana
sentences.text: Please mention the uncovered food too. I do not want us guessing which things are safe to keep.

sentences.speaker: Luis
sentences.text: I will. You message the house group, and I'll ask the manager to arrange a visit.
